projects.title: For mother of all kinds
projects.subtitle: Fertility Care App
projects.description: Many fertility clinics in South Korea turn away woman in no partnership, sometimes even in very unpleasant way. I built a shared database of clinic visit records and a website to help them find clinics opened to them.

images.alt: Fertility clinic finder with search results and a map
Clinic details with availability and reviews

projects.title: Adopt, don’t shop
projects.subtitle: Paw in Hand · Real-time Chat
projects.description: Paw in Hand is a animal adoption platform in South Korea that helps more than 20,000 abandoned animals find new homes each year. My team featured real-time chat, listening from staff, shelters, and adopters.

projects.title: A Chatbot for Nonprofits
projects.subtitle: In development
projects.description: Many nonprofits are short-staffed. Looking for a way to support them across the board, we chose a chatbot to automate routine tasks. Since people already use messaging apps like WhatsApp and KakaoTalk every day, chatbots offer an accessible way to help. Our pilot with Gyeongmyodang (animal center in Seoul) streamlines volunteer sign-ups, cancellations, and roster management.

images.alt: Volunteer sign-up chat for Mango Dev on KakaoTalk
